notes: Strip is mostly estate tracts (E.M. Pattison, German Catholic Cemetery Ass'n, J. Welsh, D. Allen's Estate, A.L. Foster, W.M. Allen's Est.). West Eighth Street runs along the top edge (south line ~y 205) with no cross streets meeting it in x 4540-6540 (the tabs above the top edge at x 5400 and 5900 are paste-on labels). Delhi is printed 'DELHI' (suffix not visible on this strip; recorded as Delhi Avenue); its south side is cut by the plate edge, so centreline points are estimated. Vaughn Street printed 'VAUGHN STREET'. No streets in x 6200-6540 (Enright Avenue lies east of 6650). Narrow double line at x ~5960-6050, y 2420-3200 is a lot boundary, not a street.
